_comment: Suggested questions for shared items (unified shares phase 2, 2026-10-29; design security/unified-shares-design-2026-10-29.md §5.2). Deterministic templates keyed by the shared root's node type; {title} is the item's exact name. Used by GET /api/share/received (and later by the share emails), so the page and the email never disagree. Every template is tested to route to the item's domain (tests/verify_received_shares.js). No LLM.

DocumentSource: What are the main findings of {title}?
What does {title} say about its method?
